summary: Explore a running candidate through realistic paths to discover unanticipated defects.

inputs.name: change-set
inputs.description: Exact candidate and changed behavior to explore.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Expected outcomes, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

inputs.name: test-plan
inputs.description: Existing checks and known coverage gaps.

completion_checks: Exploration charters and actual coverage are recorded.
Findings distinguish reproducible defects from unresolved observations.
The report identifies environment limits and untouched risk areas.
failure_modes: A reproducible behavior violation is observed: failed.
The required running surface or test identity is unavailable: blocked.
Exploration evidence cannot establish a useful conclusion: inconclusive.
